 About the match
 On this page you can find the Al-Sadd vs Al-Ahli match lineup for AFC Champions League Elite — Round 4, on Monday 02-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Al-Sadd lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Afif, while Al-Ahli sets up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Mendy. Al-Sadd is led by head coach Răzvan Lucescu, while Al-Ahli is managed by Marino Pusic. The match is played at Jassim Bin Hamad Stadium.
